skills.name: Calamity Star Illumination
skills.description: Curses the nearest enemy, preventing them from moving or attacking for a period of time, and deals damage every second equal to a percentage of her attack power.

upgrades.level3: Increases the damage dealt per second.

skills.name: Domain of Misfortune
skills.description: Creates a Misfortune aura around her, reducing the attack power of enemies within range. When actively triggered, she flies toward the enemy with the highest attack power and deals damage equal to a percentage of her attack.

upgrades.level2: Enemies within the aura also have reduced defense.
upgrades.level3: Increases the damage dealt when actively triggered.
upgrades.level4: If she dies in battle, the Misfortune aura remains at her original position for a period of time.

skills.name: Yin-Yang Curse
skills.description: Curses the mirrored-position enemy, dealing damage equal to a percentage of their max HP. The curse gradually dissipates over time and restores the HP previously lost.

upgrades.level2: During the curse duration, the target’s healing received is reduced.
upgrades.level4: Increases the debuff effects caused by the curse.

skills.name: Eternal Calamity Bind
skills.description: When she defeats an enemy, the killer permanently enters the “Misfortune” state. Enemies under Misfortune have a chance when attacking to suffer control effects (such as stun, fear, petrify, or movement speed reduction). The Misfortune effect can only trigger once every 4 seconds.

upgrades.level2: Enemies in Misfortune take damage every second equal to a percentage of her attack.
upgrades.level3: Enemies in Misfortune deal reduced damage.
upgrades.level4: The trigger chance of all negative effects under Misfortune increases.

relic.name: Source of Misfortune
relic.description: When an enemy afflicted with Misfortune dies, the Misfortune spreads to the nearest enemy and deals damage to the newly infected target.

upgrades.level2: Increases the damage dealt when spreading.
upgrades.level3: Enemies cursed by “Yin-Yang Curse” will also permanently enter the Misfortune state.
upgrades.level4: During the Misfortune duration, the target takes increased damage.
